# 094 — PR explainer (HIGH tier): protocol + chain logos on every pool row/card

## Goal
The analytics browse rows carried a text-only badge (`ON MAPLE • ETHEREUM`) and zero visual protocol/chain
identity — the last un-shipped item of the 089–095 Analytics-UX audit. SOTA yield tables all carry protocol
imagery, and the cautious-saver ICP recognizes brands visually before parsing text. This adds a small, decorative
protocol logo (with a tiny chain badge) to each row/card, so the grid reads faster and more credible — without
touching a single number, sort, filter, or trust rail.

## Intuition
Two constraints shape the whole design: the change must be **decorative** (never influence what's shown or in what
order), and it must **degrade honestly** (a blocked, slow, or missing icon must never break the layout or hide the
pool). The answer is a fixed-size box that renders either the real CDN icon or a monogram — same dimensions either
way — living in the ONE shared component both views already use.

## What changed and why (reading order)

### 1. `app.js` — new `PoolLogo` component (the whole feature)
A small `React.createElement`-only component (no JSX per CLAUDE.md), with two `useState` error flags:
- Protocol icon: `https://icons.llamao.fi/icons/protocols/<encodeURIComponent(project.toLowerCase())>?w=48&h=48`
  (curl-verified 200 image/webp). `pool.project` is already the DefiLlama slug (`aave-v3`, `morpho-blue`), so no
  transform beyond lowercase. Chain badge: `.../icons/chains/rsz_<chain.toLowerCase()>?w=48&h=48` — the `rsz_`
  prefix and the `llamao` (not `llama`) host are required; `icons.llama.fi` 404s.
- The `<img>` carries `loading="lazy"` + `decoding="async"` (never blocks render, never enters the critical path)
  and fixed `width=24 height=24`. On `error`/missing project it swaps to a `.pool-logo-monogram` chip — the
  uppercased first letter of `pool.project` — in the *same* fixed box. The chain badge simply disappears on error
  (a 14px corner accent, not identity-bearing).
- The container is `aria-hidden="true"` (the existing `.pool-context-inline` text badge carries the accessible
  identity, so we don't double-announce), but the imgs still get real `alt` text via `translations.js` per the
  a11y criterion.

### 2. `app.js` — one insertion in `renderPoolCard`
`React.createElement(PoolLogo, { project: pool.project, chain: pool.chain })` as the FIRST child of
`.pool-left-section`, before `.pool-symbol`. `renderPoolCard` is the single shared renderer for BOTH grid and list
(factored out for spec 012), so both views inherit the logo with zero duplication. Nothing else in the card
changed — the text badge stays exactly where it was (augment, not replace).

### 3. `style.css` — `.pool-logo*` rules, neuro tokens only
`.pool-logo` is a fixed 24×24 `position:relative` box (`flex:0 0 auto`). `.pool-logo-img` and
`.pool-logo-monogram` both fill exactly 24×24 (`object-fit:contain` on the image) with `--neuro-radius-sm` +
`--neuro-shadow-subtle` + `--color-surface`; the monogram uses `--color-primary` + `--font-weight-bold`.
`.pool-logo-chain` is a 14px absolute corner badge. No gradient, glow, or scale-pop. Because the box size is pinned
in CSS regardless of whether the image resolves, no icon state ever reflows the row.

### 4. `translations.js` — `poolProtocolLogoAlt` / `poolChainLogoAlt`, EN + KO together
`"<x> logo"` (EN) and `"<x> 로고"` (natural KO) in both locale blocks. `translations.min.js` regenerated.

### 5. Regenerated artifacts
`app.compiled.js`, `app.compiled.min.js`, `style.min.css`, `translations.min.js` via `node compile-app.js` +
`node minify-assets.js` (home.html loads the min bundles). PoolDetail/planner bundles rebuilt byte-identical.

### 6. `test_pool_logo.js` (new, wired into `npm test`)
Rendered-Playwright acceptance on the REAL DOM (2026-07-11 standing decision), cloned from `test_list_default.js`.
Routes the icon host — catch-all abort first, `goodproto` fulfill last (Playwright most-recent-wins) so ONE row
gets a resolving image and another (`badproto`) is forced broken. Asserts: (a) `.pool-logo` count == `.pool-card`
count + text badge preserved, grid & list; (b) goodproto row = `img.pool-logo-img[loading=lazy]` 24×24;
(c) badproto row = monogram "B" 24×24, equal box → no reflow; (d) grid toggle + `?chain=Ethereum` both keep the
logo. 5/5 green.

## Deviations from spec
1. **10 other render tests edited** (ignore-token + abort-route, two lines each) — a mandatory consequence of
   adding a new external image host to the shared render path; without it those analytics-grid tests fail on
   `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` console errors and `load`-event timeouts in-sandbox. Mirrors each file's existing
   blocked-host pattern; no assertion logic touched.
2. **`test_pool_logo.js` flips `style.min.css` `media=print`→`all`** after navigation, because home.html's
   render-blocking-CSS perf trick (`onload` swap) doesn't fire in the headless fixture load — without it the
   box-size assertions would measure unstyled elements.
Both documented in `specs/094-notes.md`.

## Trust rails
Byte-identical. `PoolLogo` reads `pool.project`/`pool.chain` only, renders no numbers, calls no sort/filter.
`git diff app.js | grep -E 'APY_SANITY_LIMIT|DEFAULT_MIN_TVL|isAnomalousApy|hasNoSupplyYield'` → empty.
`test_default_sort` (TVL-desc order) + `test_zero_yield_demote` (092 demotion + honest 0% hero) re-run green.

## Verification
- New `test_pool_logo.js`: 5/5 PASS (verifier ran it independently).
- Verifier PASS, 9/9 acceptance criteria independently re-derived, risk tier independently assigned HIGH.
- Touched render tests re-run individually green: smoke 8/8, list_default 3/3, default_sort 4/4,
  zero_yield_demote 4/4, footer_hub_links 4/4, rate_volatility 5/5, category_taxonomy 13/13,
  compiled_assets 4/4, minified_assets 9/9 (incl. translations.min byte-identity).
- Full `npm test` chain halts at `test_analytics_fires` — PRE-EXISTING sandbox failure (generated `/tokens/big`
  page `load` timeout), stash-baseline proven identical with changes removed. Diff-independent.

Render-path HIGH → needs human visual spot-check (the 003 smoke gate isn't pixel-level; sandbox blocks browser
pixel-QA — real icons are CDN-blocked in-sandbox, so the four scratchpad screenshots show the monogram fallback,
which IS the honest-degradation contract). No isolable Mixpanel funnel metric (analytics-app clarity/credibility
default — same disclosure class as 089/091/092/093/095).
